treated_stack_t_reference.description: Student t reference using the six treated-stack estimates as the effective observations

connected_component_sign_flip.description: Exact enumeration of joint sign changes over disconnected components of the stack-municipality graph
connected_component_sign_flip.component_rule: two treated stacks belong to the same component whenever they share any municipality; take transitive closure
connected_component_sign_flip.null: zero mean component contribution with sign symmetry
